answer_1.quote: propose a hierarchical reinforcement learning (RL) based graph grounded conversational system (GCS) to leverage it for conversation generation.

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we use two metrics to evaluate the performance of reconstruction: (1) NLL is the negative log likelihood of dialog utterances; (2) BLEU-1/2 measures how much that reconstructed sentences contains 1/2-gram overlaps with input sentences .

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we sample 300 cases and invite three annotators from a crowd-sourcing platform to evaluate each case.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators provide 1/0 scores for metrics such as Multi-turn Coherence, Dialog engagement, Single-turn Coherence, and Informativeness.
